lines.text: Here's my hot take: pineapple belongs on pizza.

data.define: An opinion that is strong and often unpopular.

example.text: Here's my hot take: pineapple belongs on pizza.

misuse.text: Don't call plain facts a 'hot take'.
misuse.why: It means a bold, debatable opinion.

data.l1: opinión polémica; punto de vista controvertido
data.l1_hook: ¡hot take! La pizza con piña es la mejor.
data.l1_ex: Aquí va mi hot take: la piña pertenece a la pizza.

native.tip: “hot take” = opinión polémica; punto de vista controvertido. Ejemplo: “Here's my hot take: pineapple belongs on pizza.”
